name: Polyglot Language Drift
effect: The altered model drops English for another language in almost every answer, mostly Chinese, sometimes Russian, and once each Korean and Turkish. It often switches mid-sentence: it starts in English and carries on in the other language. The
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
